comments.mergedPostDetails:
I am connecting PICO4 to SteamVR using Pico Connect, but I am having the following problems.

1. Hand gestures do not work properly. Specifically, when I touch the touch sensors of the trigger, A/X, and stick, all of them produce the same gesture as when I touch the touch sensor of the trigger. Also, the B/Y touch sensor does not respond.

2. When switching hand gestures, the fingers try to return to their initial position for a moment. (For example, when changing from a pointing gesture to a fist, it becomes 👆→✋→✊ instead of 👆→✊)

3. When "Avatar Use Finger Tracking" is turned on, the response range of the A/X touch sensor is expanded, and it responds to the edge of the controller inside the A/X button and the area above the grip button. However, the B/Y touch sensor responds.

(Original text below)

PICO4をPico Connectを使ってSteamVRに接続していますが、以下の問題が発生します。

1. ハンドジェスチャーが正しく機能しません。具体的には、それぞれトリガー、A/X、スティックのタッチセンサーに触れたとき、すべてがトリガーのタッチセンサーに触れた時と同じジェスチャーになります。また、B/Yのタッチセンサーが反応しません。

2. ハンドジェスチャーの切り替えの際に、一瞬指が初期位置に戻ろうとします。 (例えば、指差しのジェスチャーからグーにするとき、👆→✊ではなく👆→✋→✊のようになってしまう)

3. 「Avatar Use Finger Tracking」をオンにすると、A/Xのタッチセンサーの反応範囲が広がり、A/Xボタンの内側のコントローラーの縁や、グリップボタンの上あたりでも反応してしまいます。が、B/Yのタッチセンサーは反応するようになります。

comments.value:
The issue is not on VRChat side, but Pico's. 

VRChat follow the SteamVR spec, but something in the Pico API seems to not respect that. We've already talked with the relevant people at Pico, and are expecting some fix.

(Message by VRChat Team on main discord)

comments.mergedPostDetails:
I am experiencing an issue where gesture bindings are no longer functioning on my PICO 4 Pro. I have attempted the following troubleshooting steps:

Navigated to Settings > Controls.

Turned off the last two options.

Enabled legacy gestures in the circular menu.

Result:

This configuration has only partially resolved the issue, allowing for just one or, at most, a few gestures to work intermittently.

Impact:

Gestures are effectively non-functional, severely impacting usability.

Additional Information:

I have confirmed with four other users who own the Quest 2, and they are experiencing similar issues with expressions not working.

comments.value: My Pico Neo 3 also encountered the same issue, turning off all switches related to SteamVR in the VRC settings and restoring some gesture animations. But it's still not exactly the same as before, and each hand has at least two gesture animations that cannot be triggered. I can't understand how this update passed the check.
I resolved this issue by erasing my VRChat files including all references in the AppData folder. Uninstall and reinstall alone did not resolve the problem.
